referenceFunction.generalComment: Inventory for 1 MJ heat from diesel, burned in a cogeneration unit with a capacity of 1MWth. The multioutput process "diesel, burned in cogen 1MWth delivers the coproducts "heat, at cogen 1MWth, diesel, allocation exergy" and "electricity, at cogen 1MWth, diesel, allocation exergy". The energy efficiency is 44% for electricity and 42% for heat. The economic factor is 0.72 for electricity and 0.28 for heat. This leads to the allocation factor of 0.73 for electricity and 0.27 for heat.; UUID: 606b750a-6e19-35d5-88ec-5cc8e467e5ac
